name: 78629 · Gonzales, TX
findings: ZIP 78629 (Gonzales) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78629 (Gonzales) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
